metrics.profile_summary: Senior SEO and Content Lead with over 10 years of experience specializing in e-commerce organic growth. Proven track record in increasing traffic and conversion rates for US-focused brands through strategic content funnels.

experience.description: Increased organic traffic by 35% and improved top 10 keyword rankings by 25% through target keyword strategy and PDP/PLP optimization.
Drove 45% organic traffic growth and increased social content engagement by 30% while managing a content team.
Developed SEO and technical content that improved organic visibility for target keywords by 20–30%.
Produced SEO content and conducted keyword research to improve search visibility and targeting accuracy.
Delivered high-volume SEO content to drive organic traffic growth and inbound marketing leads.
Supported brand awareness campaigns and PR outreach to enhance brand positioning.
Produced research reports and content to support strategic decision-making.

strengths: Strong background in content strategy and organic growth
Proven ability to increase engagement and traffic
weaknesses: Lack of explicit mention of Meta Business Suite, Canva, or TikTok scheduling
Profile is heavily skewed toward SEO rather than social media management
Overqualified for a Specialist level role
evaluation.summary: The candidate is a highly experienced digital marketer who far exceeds the minimum experience and education requirements. However, her expertise is primarily in SEO and content leadership rather than the specific social media coordination and asset management tasks outlined in the JD.
